info.title: Facebook Conversions
info.description: Simulated Facebook Conversions API for deterministic AutomationBench workflow evaluation.

post.summary: Submit one or more server-side conversion events to Facebook through the Conversions API. Use this to report purchases, lead captures, and other conversions occurring outside the browser. Supported standard event names include: Purchase, Lead, ViewContent, AddToCart, InitiateCheckout, CompleteRegistration, AddPaymentInfo, Search, Contact, Subscribe.

parameters.name: pixelId
parameters.description: The Facebook Pixel ID to associate events with.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: Access token for a System User with appropriate permissions.

parameters.name: test_event_code
parameters.description: A test code used to validate events in Events Manager without recording real data.

post.description: Submit one or more server-side conversion events to Facebook through the Conversions API. Use this to report purchases, lead captures, and other conversions occurring outside the browser. Supported standard event names include: Purchase, Lead, ViewContent, AddToCart, InitiateCheckout, CompleteRegistration, AddPaymentInfo, Search, Contact, Subscribe. Request body: Body: {data (required, array of ConversionEvent — list of events to send; each event has: event_name (string), action_source (string), user_data (object with em, ph, fn, ln), custom_data (object with value, currency))}.

schema.description: Body: {data (required, array of ConversionEvent — list of events to send; each event has: event_name (string), action_source (string), user_data (object with em, ph, fn, ln), custom_data (object with value, currency))}

user_data.description: Hashed identifiers used to match the user: {em (email), ph (phone), fn (first name), ln (last name)}.

event_name.description: A recognized standard event name (e.g., Purchase, Lead) or a custom event label.

event_time.description: Unix timestamp indicating when the event took place.

action_source.description: The channel or surface where the conversion happened.

ConversionEvent.description: Represents a single event submitted via the Facebook Conversions API.
